findings.title: A declared break is retained only by a decision that applies it
findings.detail: The runtime remembers an interruption only as a REESTABLISH decision. (a) Another event kind that declares a break asks (breakCarrierAsk); a later decision that does not re-send the break decides on the stale plan, VALID. (b) A break declared with a clinical flag or reason routes clinically; after qualified clearance the next plain review is VALID with the stale plan, including quality in the re-entry week. (c) A break answer to UNREPORTED_TRAINING carried by a clinical route is asked again after clearance (fail-closed, P05 difference). The Founder's DX-02 decision says 'the same interruption fact is factual whatever the carrier'; the candidate meets the Phase 2 minimal scope ('the return recipe, or the decision asks') at the declaring decision but not retention after it.

findings.title: A same-day correction of a day-precision report is refused
findings.detail: The correction-chain screen compares the correction instant with the day-precision row's stored latest causal instant (the accepting decision's clock, or 23:59:59 local). The Founder listed corrections among what DX-01 must preserve; this path was never preserved and is not made worse.

verdictBasis: No BLOCKER. DX-01, the carrier fix at the declaring decision, the machine round trip with no computed machine load, and the confounded semantics are correct on every path probed; the full suite (907), conformance, regression, validation and differential reproduce; no closed history is mutated, clinical-first holds on every kind, and no stale VALID appears that R7C-FREEZE-4 did not already produce. PREREG-2 and HARNESS-2 do not weaken PREREG-1's success criteria. The one MAJOR (QE-R7D-P3-01) is a retention gap, not a regression, and is routed with conditions; the SSCTR recheck may classify its domain severity differently.
